body.title: Serial daemon driver runReviewJob
body.summary: runReviewJob drives a job to the end serially: issue pending calls one at a time with internalRetry false and each call's execution mode (cwd, timeoutMs, or reviewer session with deadlineMs = min(deadlineAt - now, per-session limit)), run deterministic stages with runStage, apply answers and failures, pass the signal into every call, and return the adapter's result. A cancelled review ends at once with AbortError and records nothing.
acceptanceChecks: Calls are serial and each runs with its execution mode.
A cancel during a call in flight ends the review at once with AbortError, no re-issue, nothing recorded.
A re-issued session never restarts the deadline.

tests.name: src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a review cancelled while a call is in flight ends at once with AbortError, no re-issue, nothing recorded'

src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a re-issued reviewer-session call gets only the remaining time to the job deadline; past the deadline no call is issued and the review fails with today's message'
